Suzhou苏州

Manufacturing depth next door to Shanghai, at half the cost.

Registered address
¥5k–15k / year
Typical setup
3–6 weeks
Region
Yangtze River Delta
Best suited to
Manufacturing, hardware, biotech, precision engineering and any founder whose factory is in the Yangtze River Delta.

Suzhou is the manufacturing heart of the Yangtze River Delta. The Suzhou Industrial Park (SIP) is a joint venture with Singapore and remains the best-run industrial park in the country, with one-stop registration, customs and environmental services, and a large base of foreign-invested factories.

For a hardware founder, the appeal is proximity: component suppliers, tooling shops, contract manufacturers and testing labs within an hour, plus Shanghai's airport and advisers within two. For a software or consumer founder, the city is quieter and the talent pool narrower.

What actually differs here?

Suzhou rewards founders who bring a manufacturing engineer, not just a business plan. The park's staff will help, but they will not design your process for you.

Industrial park space is plentiful; the SIP has premium serviced offices; rents are significantly below Shanghai with a 30-minute train link.

Before you commit to an address here

The figures on this page are ranges. District practice decides whether a specific address will register, bank and pass inspection — and it changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district market regulator and the bank to confirm the address before you sign the lease, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Registration practice

How the paperwork actually goes in Suzhou

Registry speed, address rules and the district-level differences that decide whether a plan is realistic.

Registering

Registration is through the Jiangsu provincial portal, with SIP having its own service centre and streamlined process for foreign investment. The environmental impact assessment is the long pole for any manufacturing project, and the park's own review is often stricter than the district's.

Banking

Suzhou banks are experienced with manufacturing clients, equipment finance and cross-border capital. A factory project will need to show the EIA, the lease and the capital plan before an account is opened for construction payments.

Work permits

Work permits are processed by the municipal science and technology bureau, and the SIP has a dedicated foreign-talent window. Manufacturing companies often need permits for technicians as well as managers, and the Category C route is narrower than founders expect.

Address supply

¥5k–15k / year. Expect a lease, a property certificate and a utility bill in the company's name before a bank will look at the file.

Know before you commit

Three risks in this city

  • Signing a factory lease before the EIA is approved, then discovering the site cannot be permitted.
  • Assuming the SIP's fast registration extends to environmental or fire approvals — it does not.
  • Buying used equipment from a closing factory without clear title and customs status.

Best suited to

Manufacturing, hardware, biotech, precision engineering and any founder whose factory is in the Yangtze River Delta.
